data.body:
This recurred after halfcrazed-rubbly-whimbrel landed. In run 44560626779 (main at 91322a91e9ed31b0523451b678cf2b3a40cdff8b), `sweep (windows)` job 135688612206 failed `tests/unit/test_fixture_env_repr_security.py::test_short_traceback_is_a_non_rendering_control[tests.scripts.test_autodeploy_signals_gerrit_config-deploy_box-env]` the same way: the child reported `ERROR collecting test session`, `FileNotFoundError: [WinError 2]` from `pathlib Path.lstat` on `C:\Users\runneradmin\AppData\Local\Temp\rebar-ticket-view-signed-b-fffs4i86`. Only stdlib frames survive in the log, because the child runs with `--tb=short`.

What I checked (cluster A3, session 3d705fec), without finding the enumerating frame:
- On macOS the same child invocation (cwd at the repo root, `pytest_plugins` = that module, `--basetemp` under the test dir) gets rootdir = the test's tmp dir and collects only `<Dir test-dir>`.
- An audit-hook probe on `os.scandir`/`os.listdir` saw no scan of the system temp dir.
- Neither job log shows a child `rootdir:` header or a stray `pytest.ini`/`pyproject.toml`/`conftest.py` in `%TEMP%`.
- No test in tests/ writes into `tempfile.gettempdir()` directly.

Not yet established: which code enumerates `%TEMP%` on Windows. The next check needs the full child traceback, either from a Windows run of this test with `--full-trace` or a local Windows reproduction. I am not claiming this ticket, because no root cause is in hand. It is now one of the 2 failures keeping `sweep (windows)` red (the other is eatable-gauze-moth).
